images.title: Sleep across a lifetime
images.purpose: Shows the smooth curve of daily sleep against age: high at 6, lowest between 30 and 50, a little higher later.
images.composition: One clean line graph centred in the frame with a single smooth teal curve and three labelled points. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A horizontal axis from age 6 to 75 with ticks only at 6, 30, 50 and 75, labelled 'age 6', '30', '50' and '75'. A vertical axis with no numerals, titled 'hours of sleep'. One smooth teal (#0072B2) curve: it starts high at age 6, falls through the teenage years, is lowest and nearly flat between ages 30 and 50, then rises gently to age 75, ending between the start height and the lowest height. Three reddish purple (#CC79A7) dots on the curve: at age 6 labelled 'about 9.5 hours', at age 40 labelled 'about 8 hours', and at age 75 labelled 'about 8.5 hours'. Exactly 1 curve and 3 dots.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Sleep falls from childhood, is lowest between 30 and 50, and rises a little after 50.
images.description: Shows the smooth curve of daily sleep against age: high at 6, lowest between 30 and 50, a little higher later.
images.context: Typical sleep of Indians aged 6 to 75; values are approximate readings from the graph.
images.teaching_notes: 80 close points make the curve smooth; the zoomed version stays in the video.

image_decisions.why: The story of the data is the shape of one curve; a single clean curve with three readings tells it.
